//: The ts-desktop pack (ADR 2026-063): the Electron desktop app. workspaceTemplates.desktop is the app a TN declares as `apps/<name>: desktop`: an Electron main process that hosts one context's tRPC router in-process (no network), bundled for Node with `bun build --target node --format cjs`, and a React renderer bundled from its HTML page. It depends on ts-trpc for the router it hosts, and not on ts-web: a desktop app is not a web app and must not inherit the web app's obligations. Its template pins React itself.

desktop.description: An Electron app: src/main/main.ts opens the window and calls the context's router in-process through composeApp().createCaller({}); src/renderer/ is the React page it loads.
